11071|f5e60885.name: Mot Dawnstrider
11071|f5e60885.text: What I wouldn't give to be out on the open plains on a day like this... but, my duty binds me.

14728|b050140a.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|b050140a.text:
Hail brother... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We $r have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of $r everywhere in helping us out!

3008|b0fd68db.name: Mak
3008|b0fd68db.text: Cleanse your hands before you begin any project. Staining the leather with blood or dirt would take away from its natural beauty.

3026|0c543544.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3033|b554cff6.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|b554cff6.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3050|18f1109b.name: Veren Tallstrider
3050|18f1109b.text: The $r are sons and daughters of the Earthmother, and we show respect to all her children.  Even the beasts we slay are cherished, as their bodies give nourishment and their skins provide warmth.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3084|88b3adee.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|88b3adee.text: There is a symmetry in the idea of the hide of your enemy providing you with protection.  To further your leatherworking skills look for Una inside the Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

6746|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

744-complete.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-complete.text:
Thank you for your help, $N.

My part in my brother's ceremony is almost complete. Giving him his headdress and witnessing the ceremony are all my duty requires of me.
744-complete.title: Preparation for Ceremony

744-progress.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-progress.text: This headdress will certainly be a wonderful gift for my brother.
744-progress.title: Preparation for Ceremony

760-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
760-complete.text:
You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, $N.

May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.
760-complete.title: Wildmane Cleansing

768-accept.name: Veren Tallstrider
768-accept.text:
Greetings, young one.  You have a gleam in your eye; I can tell you are eager to venture back to the plains for the hunt.  May you bring honor to your clan!

I work with the skins of beasts, fashioning them into clothes and armor for the people of Thunder Bluff.

If you hunt beasts and bring me their skins, then I will fashion something for you.
768-accept.title: Gathering Leather

768-complete.name: Veren Tallstrider
768-complete.text:
Ah, these are very nice pieces.  They'll make fine leather goods.

Here, $N.  Take this in trade...
768-complete.title: Gathering Leather

768-progress.name: Veren Tallstrider
768-progress.text: Hello again.  Have you been hunting?  Do you have skins for me?
768-progress.title: Gathering Leather

769-accept.name: Veren Tallstrider
769-accept.text:
The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us.  If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.

Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
769-accept.title: Kodo Hide Bag

775-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
775-complete.text: Hail, young $c. I see you found your way to my doorstep.
775-complete.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff

776-accept.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-accept.text:
You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.

But in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.

We are hunters, $N. Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.
776-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

776-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-complete.text:
Well done! A fine kill that was.

I will send a gathering party to collect the carcass so we can retrieve the hide and meat.

You have done a great deed for your people, $N.
776-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

776-progress.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-progress.text: Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?
776-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

7820-progress.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
7820-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Thunder Bluff for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7820-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

860-accept.name: Melor Stonehoof
860-accept.text:
If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the Barrens.  Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce.  You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.

Speak with Sergra Darkthorn.  She will be your first guide in the Barrens.

Sergra is at the Crossroads.  To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the Barrens, then north as the road forks.  And have care as you travel--the Barrens holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.
860-accept.title: Sergra Darkthorn

98435-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
98435-accept.text:
Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.

Please, take this to Arch $C Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.
98435-accept.title: Thunderhorn's Report

99082-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
99082-complete.text:
The Galak centaur dare show themselves in Mulgore?!

You have brought pride to your ancestors by driving them out. Perhaps that will remind them of the pain that awaits them should they do so again!

Please accept this gift in honor of this. May it serve you well as you venture out into the Earth Mother's kingdom, to the far reaches of this world.
99082-complete.title: The High Chieftain
